caseNameFull: Lockhart, Director, Arkansas Department of Correction v. Fretwell

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 908.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Ricky B. Medlock, Esq., of Little Rock, Ark., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
